snippet.title: ANTHEM#9 - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ANTHEM#9 

Stack smart. Strike hard. Strategic Gem Match Roguelite!

Combine gems to chain combos and defeat enemies! Chain skills and unleash combos within the time limit to defeat your opponents. You'll need both build powerful decks and quick thinking to connect combos. A classic puzzle game blending rich core gameplay with the thrill of deck-building roguelites!

#roguelite #puzzle #deckbuilder #anthem9

Genre: Gem Match Roguelite
Platforms: Steam®
Release Date: February 4th, 2026
Developer: koeda
